{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')
# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
# Remove QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df_clean = df[df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]
print(f"Number of rows after removing QA orders: {len(df_clean)}")"}
